subject: math.OA
name: Commutative Gelfand–Naimark theorem
statement: Every commutative unital complex C*-algebra A is isometrically *-isomorphic to C(X), where X is its compact Hausdorff space of characters. The isomorphism sends a to the function χ ↦ χ(a).

subject: math.OA
name: Gelfand–Naimark representation theorem
statement: Every complex C*-algebra admits a faithful isometric *-representation as a norm-closed *-subalgebra of the bounded operators on some Hilbert space.

subject: math.OA
name: GNS construction theorem
statement: For every state φ on a unital C*-algebra A, there are a Hilbert space H, a *-representation π of A, and a cyclic unit vector Ω such that φ(a) = ⟨π(a)Ω,Ω⟩. This cyclic representation is unique up to a unitary intertwining both π and Ω.

subject: math.OA
name: Spectral radius theorem for normal C*-elements
statement: For a normal element a of a unital C*-algebra, its spectral radius equals its norm: max over λ in σ(a) of |λ| = ‖a‖.

subject: math.OA
name: Continuous functional calculus
statement: For a normal element a of a unital C*-algebra A, there is a unique isometric unital *-homomorphism C(σ(a)) → A sending the coordinate function z to a. Its image is the C*-subalgebra generated by a and the identity.

subject: math.OA
name: Gelfand–Mazur theorem
statement: Every complex unital Banach algebra in which every nonzero element is invertible is isometrically isomorphic to ℂ, assuming the identity has norm one.

subject: math.OA
name: Von Neumann double commutant theorem
statement: For a unital *-subalgebra M of B(H), its closure in the strong operator topology, its closure in the weak operator topology, and its double commutant M″ are the same algebra.

subject: math.OA
name: Kaplansky density theorem
statement: If a C*-subalgebra A of B(H) has strong operator closure M, the unit ball of A is strongly dense in the unit ball of M.

subject: math.OA
name: Sakai characterization of von Neumann algebras
statement: A C*-algebra is *-isomorphic to a von Neumann algebra if and only if, as a Banach space, it is isometrically the continuous dual of a Banach space.

subject: math.OA
name: Kadison transitivity theorem
statement: If π is an irreducible representation of a C*-algebra A on H, E is a finite-dimensional subspace of H, and T is a linear map E → H, there is a in A such that π(a)x = Tx for every x in E.

subject: math.OA
name: Russo–Dye theorem
statement: The closed unit ball of a unital C*-algebra is the norm-closed convex hull of its unitary elements.

subject: math.OA
name: Kadison–Schwarz inequality
statement: If Φ is a unital 2-positive map between C*-algebras, then Φ(a)*Φ(a) ≤ Φ(a*a) for every a. Here 2-positive means applying Φ entrywise to 2-by-2 matrices preserves positivity.

references.title: Paulsen: Completely Bounded Maps and Operator Algebras

subject: math.OA
name: Stinespring dilation theorem
statement: For a completely positive map Φ from a unital C*-algebra A to B(H), there exist a Hilbert space K, a *-representation π:A → B(K), and a bounded V:H → K with Φ(a) = V*π(a)V. If Φ is unital, V can be chosen to be an isometry.

subject: math.OA
name: Arveson extension theorem
statement: Let S be a self-adjoint linear subspace containing the identity in a unital C*-algebra A. Every completely positive map S → B(H) extends to a completely positive map A → B(H).

references.title: Paulsen: Completely Bounded Maps and Operator Algebras

subject: math.OA
name: Tomiyama theorem
statement: A linear projection of norm one from a C*-algebra A onto a C*-subalgebra B is positive and B-bimodular: P(b₁ab₂) = b₁P(a)b₂ for a in A and b₁,b₂ in B.

subject: math.OA
name: Choi complete-positivity criterion
statement: A linear map Φ:Mₙ(ℂ) → Mₘ(ℂ) is completely positive if and only if its Choi matrix Σᵢ,ⱼ Eᵢⱼ ⊗ Φ(Eᵢⱼ) is positive semidefinite. The Eᵢⱼ are the matrix units.

references.title: Choi's theorem on completely positive maps — Wikipedia

subject: math.OA
name: Choi–Kraus representation theorem
statement: A linear map Φ:Mₙ(ℂ) → Mₘ(ℂ) is completely positive if and only if there are finitely many m-by-n matrices Vⱼ such that Φ(X) = Σⱼ VⱼXVⱼ*. It is unital exactly when Σⱼ VⱼVⱼ* = Iₘ.

subject: math.OA
name: Murray–von Neumann comparison theorem
statement: For projections p,q in a von Neumann algebra M, there is a central projection z such that zp is subequivalent to zq and (1−z)q is subequivalent to (1−z)p. A projection e is subequivalent to f when some partial isometry v in M has v*v = e and vv* ≤ f.

subject: math.OA
name: Tomita–Takesaki theorem
statement: Let M be a von Neumann algebra acting on a complex Hilbert space H with a cyclic separating vector Ω, and let S be the closure of the operator aΩ ↦ a*Ω for a in M. In the polar decomposition S = JΔ¹/², one has JMJ = M′ and ΔⁱᵗMΔ⁻ⁱᵗ = M for every real t.

subject: math.OA
name: Takesaki conditional-expectation theorem
statement: Let φ be a faithful normal state on a von Neumann algebra M and N a unital von Neumann subalgebra. A φ-preserving normal conditional expectation from M onto N exists if and only if N is invariant under every modular automorphism σₜφ; when it exists, it is unique.

references.title: Takesaki: Theory of Operator Algebras II
